text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, full-fledged training
with Taiki Shuttle finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Taiki Shuttle's sake, who was so happy to see me get a Trainer, I have to fire myself up and train hard...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I arrived at the meeting spot,
but Taiki Shuttle is nowhere to be seen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after waiting for 30 minutes.
Just as I took out my phone to contact her—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I went to the racetrack thinking the races started today! How clumsy of me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, barely safe! I have returned!
I'm so glad I made it in time for training, YES!
choice_data_list: That's totally out, I'm telling you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! That sour face...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Trainer-san,
you were lonely all by yourself, weren't you...!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yeees, I understand.
Being lonely is very sad.
It is the same for me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But! I won't let you be alone anymore!
Don't worry, it's okay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start training!
Bring on the hard work, c'mon~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I will focus and make up for the lost time!
I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I psyched myself up, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, my friend is running over there!
My friend!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Unfortunately, Taiki Shuttle's attention span didn't even last two seconds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My days with the cheerful, lively, and larger-than-life Taiki Shuttle
seemed destined to be full of twists and turns—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! That training was lots of fun, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I kept charging right toward you over and over, Friend.
I am so sorry for that, yes!
choice_data_list: Still, you managed to finish the whole routine.
Still, you managed to finish the whole routine.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer-san's training menu
suits me so well. It's really fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that's right!
Trainer, do you have some time to keep me company?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle flashed a beaming smileand led me away to—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "We have arrived, yes! Now then—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's choose!
Trainer, which milk would you like?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When we fight, we toast with milk!
That's my family's rule!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Milk is awesome!
It gives you power, and makes you big too, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Look! I drank plenty of it too, and look how big I've gotten!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"So you should get full of power
with milk too, Trainer-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Toward the Twinkle Series—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While she was just as wild and boisterous as ever,
I could feel that Taiki Shuttle was truly
fired up in her own way...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well then, wishing for VICTORY—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Cheers！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew, delicious♪
Milk really does give me power, after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —I'm sure my family is back in Kentucky milking the cows today, eagerly waiting to see me shine.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to deliver
this big happy news to you, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!
Let's challenge ourselves, together!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, the fast-approaching Make a Debut—
I'll keep building up training toward that!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together, we made a vow to give it our all from here on out...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Oh! Lounging around too much is a no-no.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's move on to the next one,
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!
My family has many more rules where that came from!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When we fight, we toast with milk!
Aaand...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
BIG BIG STEAK!!
Nothing else will DO!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And with that, let's goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To reach Taiki Shuttle's goal, I have to keep up with her dynamic spirit!
It was a day that left me thinking just that.
